_purpose: The single declared source for every number in the PRISMA diagram. docs/PRISMA_FLOW.md narrates the process and had accumulated three strata written on different days, with a headline Included section reading 6 trials and 43 rows while its own later update sections recorded 440 included records and a 524 row master. A diagram drawn from that file could be off by an order of magnitude depending on which section the reader believed. Numbers live here, once, each with the source that fixed it; the prose points here. src/prisma_diagram.py asserts the arithmetic before drawing anything.
_generated_from: docs/PRISMA_FLOW.md and the search logs it cites

stream_a_identification._note: Our own searching. PubMed anchors plus Embase and CENTRAL on 15 October and Web of Science on 16 October.

stream_b_adopted._note: Mono agonist comparator pool adopted from two published reviews, not independently searched. Shown as a separate inflow because their screening was done by other groups; PRISMA_FLOW.md requires that a single merged diagram is not drawn.

title_abstract_screening._note: Three pools, screened on different days, which is why no single number in the narrative equals the full text pool. Pool 1 is the 659 Embase articles under criteria v1 plus the v2 rescreen of its exclusions. Pool 2 is the 51 Embase registry plus 200 CENTRAL only records under v2. Pool 3 is the 99 Web of Science records in neither other database, screened as batch 3 under v2. The 547 figure that appears in docs/PRISMA_FLOW.md is pools 1 and 2 only and predates pool 3; the full text pool is 576 because pool 3 contributed 29. Resolved 19 October from search/screening/FULLTEXT_POOL_SUMMARY.md, which states the composition by stage, and search/screening/SCREENING_SUMMARY_batch3_v2.md.

full_text_stage._note: Counts as recorded in the 16 October 14:30 update. The pool of 576 is the sum of the three screening pools' includes: 338 + 24 + 185 + 29. This reconciles, and the apparent excess over 547 that stood here until 19 October was pool 3.

grouping_and_extraction._note: Included records group into candidate studies by DOI, title and registry identifier. Ledger statuses as at the 16 October 16:00 update, when the queue closed and every group carried a terminal status.

included_in_synthesis._note: The corpus as the master holds it. Supersedes the stale headline figures of 6 trials and 43 rows in PRISMA_FLOW.md.
